## 1. Goal

Final pass over the redesigned site: accessibility, motion preferences, responsive behaviour, offline check and a last design audit. Supersedes K-39 (#45): dark mode and keyboard shortcuts are delivered by K-43 and this issue.

## 2. Background

**Design authority:** `docs/design/APPLE_DESIGN.md` (added by K-43). Direction "soft sheets": flat solid colours, hairline borders, one whisper shadow, translucent top bar and dock (`backdrop-filter`, solid fallback under `prefers-reduced-transparency` and `prefers-contrast: more`), no gradients except the scroll-edge fade, no glows, neon, purple, emoji icons or monospace fonts. System sans-serif only; numbers use `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`.

**Palette (final):** light canvas `#F2F3F1`, surface `#FFFFFF`, text `#1B1F1D`, muted `#5B625E`, border `#CFD3D0`, accent teal `#0B5E6B`, red `#B42318`, amber `#8A4B00`, green `#1D7A34`, chart gray `#8A918D`. Dark: canvas `#121513`, surface `#1B1F1D`, text `#ECEFED`, muted `#A3ABA6`, border `#343A37`, accent `#5FB6C4`, red `#F0877C`, amber `#E0A24A`, green `#6FCB87`, chart gray `#8A918D`. Chart gray is for chart marks and rules only, never text.

**Rules that do not change (CLAUDE.md rule 7, PRD §7 and §8):** classic scripts on `window.APRM`, no ES modules, no `fetch`, no framework, no build step; works from `file://` offline; `textContent` only for user, file, URL and engine text; loading, empty and error states on every view; colours as CSS variables with light and dark values; Chart.js only in Compare, pinned with SRI, with a table fallback. Nothing here touches `core/`, `wasm/` or PRD §5, and every number shown must equal the engine JSON.

**Tone:** short plain sentences, sentence case, talk to the user. Plain words first, technical term beside them ("Shortest job first (SJF)"). Engine sentences (why log, validation errors) are shown verbatim; the UI may add a plain lead-in but never rewrites them. "Show details" (K-43) reveals the full technical view: exact numbers, raw aged keys, heap order, log kinds.

## 3. Scope

**In scope:**

- WCAG AA contrast check of every pair, both modes; focus rings visible on every control
- Keyboard-only walk through the whole flow; tab order
- Reduced motion, reduced transparency and increased contrast behave as designed
- No sideways scroll at laptop widths; 200% zoom
- PRD §10 website checklist run by hand and recorded
- Impeccable audit and polish run once; findings fixed in one batch; DESIGN.md recorded

**Out of scope:**

- New features

## 4. Files

| Path | Create / modify | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| web/css/*, web/js/* | modify | Fixes found by the audit |
| DESIGN.md | create | Design system record (Impeccable document) |
| docs/design/screenshots/ | create | Before and after, light and dark |

## 5. Specification

No new behaviour. Every fix is backed by a test or a recorded check.

## 6. Step-by-step tasks

1. Run the contrast, keyboard and media-query passes
2. Run the PRD §10 website checklist from file:// with the network off
3. Run Impeccable audit once; fix everything in one batch; confirm once
4. Write DESIGN.md and add screenshots

## 7. Tests to write

| Test name | What it checks | Expected result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| no-hscroll | 1280 px wide window | No horizontal scroll |
| a11y-keyboard | Full flow by keyboard | Every control reachable, focus visible |
| media | Reduced motion/transparency/contrast | Fallbacks apply |
| offline | file:// with the network off | All three pages work |

## 8. Acceptance criteria (Done when)

- [ ] All six presets load, play, step and finish
- [ ] A job added mid-run appears and is scheduled
- [ ] CSV export then import gives the same case
- [ ] Compare metrics equal the console program
- [ ] Invalid input shows the engine message beside the field
- [ ] Opens from file:// with the network off
- [ ] Contrast, keyboard, reduced-motion passes recorded in the PR

## 9. How to verify

Follow `docs/DEMO.md` (or the PRD §10 website checklist) by hand and record each box in the PR.

## 10. Viva notes

The checklist is the evidence the demo will not fail. Examiner question: "Does it work offline?" Yes, classic scripts and bundled data, no network.

## 11. Pitfalls

- Open-ended polishing: one audit round, one fix batch, one confirmation round, then stop
